title.en: Banking Sector Reforms in India: Basel Norms
title.hi: Banking Sector Reforms in India: Basel Norms

definition.en: Basel Norms are international banking regulations established by the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision to ensure financial stability by setting minimum capital requirements for banks.
definition.hi: Basel Norms are international banking regulations established by the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision to ensure financial stability by setting minimum capital requirements for banks.

importanceInUpsc.en: These norms are critical for UPSC GS-3 as they directly impact the health of the Indian banking sector and the RBI's regulatory framework. Understanding these reforms is essential for analyzing banking crises, non-performing assets (NPAs), and the overall stability of the Indian economy.
